blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) has once again been named Best Developer in the Philippines at the 13th PropertyGuru Philippines Property Awards—marking its fourth consecutive win, further solidifying its status as a leader in the country’s real estate industry.

Receiving the Best Developer–Philippines award in 2022, 2023, 2024, and now 2025 stands as a testament to RLC's steadfast dedication to quality, thoughtful planning, and delivering spaces that inspire and endure.

“We at RLC are deeply honored and thankful to be chosen as Best Developer for the fourth consecutive time. This win is a milestone that validates our consistency, innovation, and dedication to serving the Filipino people,” said RLC President and CEO Mybelle V. Aragon-GoBio. “As we celebrate 45 years of purposeful progress, RLC continues to build with excellence, ingenuity, and impact—shaping a future where every space reflects our mission to build better lives.”

RLC, which has been serving nearly every facet of Filipino life for almost half a century now, has 300 developments nationwide including 56 malls, 32 office developments and 11 co-working hubs, 26 hotels and resorts, 134 residential developments, 33 destination estates and mixed-use communities, and 13 logistics and industrial facilities.

Aragon-GoBio recognized the hard work of the many people who make up RLC. “This win wouldn’t be possible without the dedication and passion of our entire team—employees, partners, and stakeholders—who continuously strive to bring our vision to life. It’s a reflection of the trust our customers and partners place in us—something we are always grateful for.”

JG Summit Holdings President & CEO and RLC Chairman Lance Y. Gokongwei was given the inaugural Life Achievement Award at the ceremony—an honor that celebrates a lifetime of visionary leadership and enduring impact on the industry. Together, these victories mark a powerful chapter in RLC’s legacy of excellence.
RLC won 30 other awards at the event.
Robinsons Land was named Best Developer (Luzon) affirming its expansive reach and steadfast commitment to excellence across the country.
It also bagged the Best Sustainable Developer award, testament to its dedication to building environmentally responsible spaces and promoting long-term sustainability in real estate.

The company was likewise honored as Best Luxury Developer, recognizing its ability to craft sophisticated, high-end developments that deliver elevated living experiences and reflect world-class design, comfort, and prestige.
RLove by Robinsons Land Foundation, Inc., which champions social welfare through philanthropy, volunteerism, and collaborative advocacy was given the Social Impact Award.

Robinsons Offices, the office development and leasing arm of RLC, received the Best Commercial Developer award. Its developments in different parts of the country had multiple other wins. Cybergate Iloilo Tower 2 was declared Best Office Development. Built not just for business but for balance, this LEED-certified office building in Pavia stands as a beacon of sustainable progress in Iloilo, designed with people at its core.

Cybergate Dumaguete won Highly Commended BPO Office Development. This premium three-level office building within the Robinsons Dumaguete complex offers 7,200 square meters of BPO-grade space—the first of its kind in Negros Oriental. Designed to support local careers and community growth, it features smart, flexible interiors, seamless mall access, sustainable technologies, and excellent connectivity to transport hubs, making it a catalyst for regional progress rooted in homegrown potential.

GBF Centers 1 & 2, which exemplify Robinsons Offices’ vision of building future-ready workspaces that are as sustainable as they are sophisticated, were awarded Best Green Commercial Development. Recently certified LEED Gold v4, GBF Centers 1 & 2 are the largest office development in the Philippines to reach this green building milestone. With energy-efficient systems, rooftop solar panels, water-saving features, and wellness-focused design elements, these buildings create a healthier and more sustainable workspace for today’s workforce.

GBF Center 2, located at the gateway of Bridgetowne Destination Estate, was also given the awards for Best Office Architectural Design and Best Office Interior Design. Its standout feature is its inverted silhouette, with expanding floorplates as the tower rises. It offers premium spaces and panoramic views of Ortigas and the Sierra Madre mountains. Located at the intersection of major roads, GBF Center 2 combines striking modern design, energy-efficient features, and prime accessibility.

The award for Best Co-Working Space was given to work.able GBF Center 1. Tucked within the vibrant Bridgetowne Destination Estate, work.able’s first premium center combines Filipino heritage and modern functionality, featuring bahay-na-bato-inspired design, Vigan tiles, and thoughtfully crafted spaces like private offices, a townhall, and sleeping pods that honor rest.

RLC Residences, the residential brand of Robinsons Land which offers homes that are well-designed, built to last, and ready for the future, was honored for its focus on sustainability—it received the Sustainable Design Award and Energy Efficiency Award.

RLC Residences’ developments, which encapsulate its mantra "Raise, Live, and Connect," also received recognition. Le Pont Residences, RLC Residences’ first premium high-rise development in the Bridgetowne estate, won Highly Commended High-End Condo (Luzon). Le Pont, French for "The Bridge," offers one- to three-bedroom units and bi-level penthouses with smart-home features and loggias, complemented by expansive, hyper-sized amenities. It's the first and only EDGE-certified residential development in Bridgetowne.

Mantawi Residences, RLC Residences’ first premium condominium project in Cebu, was given the Highly Commended High-End Condo (Metro Cebu) and Best Condo Development (Visayas) awards. This four-tower development in Mandaue City features spacious one- to three-bedroom units and expansive penthouses with smart-home devices and loggia. Residents here will soon enjoy a 1.3-hectare area with beach-inspired pools, a pet park, landscaped gardens, and retail offerings—convenience and comfort in a masterfully planned space.

Luxury residential tower The Residences at The Westin Manila bagged the Best Completed Condo Development award. Located in Ortigas Center and developed by RLC Residences in partnership with Marriott International, it's the first Westin-branded residence in Southeast Asia. It features thoughtful design, premium finishes, sweeping city views and hotel-inspired amenities including The Haven’s four levels of leisure and business facilities, Sky Lounge, fitness studios, and an indoor lap pool.

SYNC by RLC Residences, a four-tower residential project located along C5 Road in Bagong Ilog, Pasig City, won Best Mid-End Condo (Manila). Designed for modern millennials on a quest for work-life balance, it features more than 30 indoor and outdoor amenities.

Sierra Valley Gardens, the first smart suburban community in Cainta, Rizal, was hailed Highly Commended Eco-Friendly Condo. Blending sanctuary, sustainability, and connectivity in one vibrant address, Sierra Valley Garden's many features include green innovations such as solar panels, rainwater harvesting, and EV charging provisions.

Springdale Baliwag won Highly Commended Subdivision Development. Strategically located in Bulacan, a convenient 90 minutes from Manila, this gated subdivision by RLC Residences offers affordable house-and-lots for families. The move-in ready homes with parking slot and gardens are complemented by amenities like a multi-purpose clubhouse, pools, a multi-sport outdoor court, a children's playground, and pocket parks.

Robinsons Malls’ NUSTAR Mall brought home three accolades: Best Retail Development, Best Retail Architectural Design and Best Retail Interior Design. This four-level lifestyle destination features sleek architecture, a curated blend of global and local art, and an impressive lineup of world-renowned fashion and beauty brands. It is also home to acclaimed dining spots including the award-winning Mott 32 plus family-friendly attractions.

Robinsons Destination Estates’ The Victor was named Best Landmark Development. The 60-meter-tall art installation at the heart of Bridgetowne, Robinsons Land’s flagship master-planned estate, is a proud symbol of Filipino resilience, ambition, and progress.

Robinsons Hotels and Resorts (RHR), known for showcasing signature Filipino hospitality, was recognized with several honors including Best Hospitality Developer and Best Operational Hospitality Developer. RHR stands as the Philippines’ largest hotel group in terms of property count, renowned for its wide-ranging portfolio of hotels and resorts. Fili Hotel Bridgetowne, the Philippines’ first homegrown 5-star hospitality brand, was awarded Best Hotel Development.
